title: Owala Spider-Man FreeSip Sway Stainless Steel Water Bottle 30 oz

reviews.title: Absolutely Love This Darth Vader Owala!
reviews.body: As both a Star Wars fan and an Owala fan, this tumbler is the perfect combination of style and functionality. The Darth Vader design looks amazing in person and gets compliments everywhere I take it. The quality is exactly what I’ve come to expect from Owala—durable, leak-proof, and keeps my drinks cold for hours.The FreeSip lid is incredibly convenient, whether I want to sip through the built-in straw or take a regular drink. It fits comfortably in my cup holder, is easy to clean, and the design details make it a must-have for any Star Wars collector.If you’re on the fence, don’t hesitate. This tumbler is both practical and a fantastic piece of Star Wars merchandise. May the Force be with your hydration!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 3, 2026
reviews.author: Stephanie Oakley

reviews.title: Owala is the best ever and only cup you need
reviews.body: Absolutely love this cup!  Owala is amazing and so easy to clean and use. No spills and super durable.  Also fits in the car drink holder! Love the extra protection of the locking lid.  And the Grogu design is super cute as well.  Great for all my coffee in the morning and water in the afternoon as it keeps everything the perfect temperature! Get one! You won’t be disappointed!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 6, 2026
reviews.author: Momof3boys

reviews.title: Buy the cup!!
reviews.body: Literally in love! I had another Owala cup and decided to invest in a second one. After using mine for almost a year now I have a few takeaways!Cons-  The cups are *mostly durable. A HARD drop or fall can possibly dent, break, or scratch the cup.Some of the paint patterns/designs may be more prone to scratches, and may need hand washing.The straw and lid can be a bit difficult to clean.Pros-Comfortable gripFits in almost all cup holdersSo easy to use and refillKeeps my drinks cool throughout the day and night. No complaints there.No issues with leaking once closedThe lid locking mechanism is a fantastic quality for traveling.Lots of unique styles and colors- can mix and match parts if you have multiple cupsReasonable priced (some designs can be a bit higher priced)-there’s also handy accessories that you can add like bottom grips and soft para cord handles! Makes it great to customize.I also need Owala to come out with more designs!! I love my glow in the dark Star Wars cup!Get the cup!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 30, 2026
reviews.author: MDecker

reviews.title: Perfect for Star Wars fans—great quality and design!
reviews.body: I absolutely love this Owala bottle! The Star Wars Millennium Falcon design looks even better in person, and the quality is amazing. It keeps my drinks cold for hours, the lid is super convenient, and it’s comfortable to carry around. If you’re a Star Wars fan, this bottle is definitely worth it. Highly recommend!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 28, 2026
reviews.author: Elaf alfoudari

reviews.title: Nice all in 1 bottle
reviews.body: I really enjoy this bottle, switched from a 28oz hydroflask tumbler with straw lid to this. Its just more versatile, I can use it at a desk or take it camping. With the hydroflask I usually took a bottle camping and would only use the tumbler at work or home. It's nice having just one that does it all. The Darth Vader is pretty subtle and looks nice. Doesn't fit in my cup holder but it is only made to fit a can of soda so I wasn't surprised. Decently easy to clean. Straw doesn't reach all the way but you can just sip to finish it off. Comfy handle makes it easy to carry. Fits the side slot of my north face backpack.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 26, 2026
reviews.author: mack walker

reviews.title: Best water bottle
reviews.body: Bought this for my husband who loves spider-man, he loves it! it hold water and ice for like two days! we love the sway version so it fits in cup holders too! design is so good definitely not coming off.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 2, 2026
reviews.author: kaley

reviews.title: So many improvements!
reviews.body: Okay.  First off is Star Wars so that rocks.  But the design is a step up from Owala bottles past in many ways. I have a 40 Oz bottle in the old design and love it. Keeps drinks cold for at least a day if not longer.  This one is 30oz but has a more substantial carry handle that easily folds out of the way.  Bigger opening at the top to make cleaning the inside easier. There is also a lock behind the flip lid to prevent unexpected opening. And it tapers at the base so it will fit in a car cup holder! Looking forward to this new edition. Will most likely order more for friends and family!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 24, 2026
reviews.author: Chuck M.

reviews.title: Solid water bottle, Star Wars / Vader !
reviews.body: Great Star Wars collab , glad it tapers enough to fit my cupholders! Lots of compliments, great Vader design . I have other Owala water bottles, seals up well , nice sip or chug option , doesn't leak . May the Force be with you, this is the way !

reviews.author: Mark

features: 30-ounce insulated stainless steel water bottle with extra features: includes a 2-in-1 spout that lets you choose how you drink; push-button, leak-proof lid that locks for all your adventures
Choose your sip style—straw or swig: Patented 2-in-1 FreeSip spout is one of a kind; it lets you sip upright through the built-in straw or swig by tilting back the spout
Hygienic push-button lid and easy carry handle: closed lid keeps spout covered and clean between sips; ergonomic bucket handle makes transport easy for sports, campsites, road trips, school, and work
Keeps water cold and fits where you need: Triple-layer insulation keeps drinks colder up to 24 hours; wide opening for easy cleaning and extra ice; cupholder friendly base fits most car cupholders
Safe materials and simple care instructions: BPA, lead, and phthalate-free for safe drinking; hand wash the cup,lid is dishwasher safe and can be easily disassembled; not for use with hot liquids
